about: Chernivtsi: Austrian heritage and the hills of Bukovina

Chernivtsi has a whole ensemble from the Austrian era: Viennese façades, buildings with high ceilings and stucco, and the Residence of Metropolitans, a UNESCO World Heritage site. The outskirts have new complexes, and the hills around are private houses overlooking the city and the Prut.

Chernivtsi is a city of sloping streets and plots with level differences. Houses here need retaining walls, drainage and terraces, while apartments in old buildings need a check of floors and services.

For apartments in Austrian buildings — an interior that keeps the proportions and details, with a modern kitchen and bathroom. For hillside houses — terraces on several levels, panoramic windows and stairs as part of the interior. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate apartments in older buildings, with a survey of floors and services, and in new builds, as well as houses. In Bukovina we build aerated-block, brick, log and timber-frame houses that take the terrain and soils into account.

Renovation is carried out by our salaried team: from $550 per m² for works and rough materials, with finishing materials, furniture and appliances priced separately per estimate. Scope, schedule and payment plan (50/50, 50/30/20 or in stages, from a 10% advance) are fixed in the contract; team travel is on individual terms. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m² — see [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Design and approvals run online; we travel for measurements and key stages on the schedule set in the contract, and the terms and costs of travel and team accommodation are individual. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks, and an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.

faq: Do you work with apartments in Chernivtsi's historic buildings?
Yes: a survey of floors and services, a project that respects the historic details, and renovation by our team.
Can you build on a sloping plot?
Yes. The foundation, retaining walls and drainage are designed after we receive the site survey data.
How much does a design project in Chernivtsi cost?
From $30 per m², minimum $2,500. The planning package starts from $6 per m², the full package with designer supervision from $45 per m².
